items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: I had Hunter Gray, a little fellow we called 'Shoe Sole'.

ctx.x: So back to the other now, we were headed on and went on back to Oklahoma and Rene and I began to keep in close contact and we went

back through there, we got some more bookings, through the west coast and I was working on that in order to get back there. I got back out there and I don't know what in the world happened but Spurgeon couldn't go on that trip or something, something happened with him, but I had Hunter Gray, a little fellow we called "Shoe Sole".
